bodycomp.date_note: early Aug 2026, read from the history graph on the Oct 29 InBody sheet

notes.hr_resolution: Hourly average heart rate — the finest grain Paul's phone syncs to Muse (no continuous samples). Workout charts show the day's hourly curve with the session window highlighted.
notes.burn_definition: total_energy_burned_kcal from Health Connect (basal + active). Net = intake - total burn. Days whose burn is still syncing (today, under 20 hours of HR) are excluded from net and the moving average.
notes.workout_energy: Per-workout energy from Health Connect is not shown: median 11 kcal across 56 sessions, implausibly low (e.g. 5 kcal for 30 min at HR avg 148). Duration and heart rate are shown instead.
